comments.value: This request is still highly relevant today.
The problem is not only that Show Avatar bypasses Safety Settings, but also that it effectively overrides distance-based avatar culling.
In large public instances, a single manually shown avatar can remain rendered regardless of distance and continue consuming resources.
It would be much better if "Show Avatar" only allowed visibility while still respecting performance protections such as Avatar Culling, distance limits, and texture memory restrictions.
An optional "Override All Safety Settings" toggle could be provided separately for users who explicitly want that behavior.

details:
As the title suggests I think it would be nice to be able to turn on/off shaders, animations, particles and avatar sounds per individual. 

I often run around with animations, particles and avatar sounds turned off for everyone but friends and often times someone will have an effect I'm not friends with that I would like to see without turning everything on for everyone with that rank and only for that person. Or there's occasionally one of my own friends that has obnoxious effects on their model, I don't want to have to turn everything off for all my friends... only that one person.

Being able to adjust these settings by individual would greatly help these situations.
title: Adjust Safety Settings for Individuals
